mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO shortlink_ownership_backfill_checkpoints ( tenant_id, application_id, domain_id, last_scanned_link_id, scan_exhausted ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{applicationId}, #{domainId}, 0, b'0' )
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, application_id, domain_id, last_scanned_link_id, scan_exhausted FROM shortlink_ownership_backfill_checkpoints WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT sl.id FROM short_links sl WHERE sl.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sl.id > #{afterLinkId} AND sl.application_id IS NULL AND sl.domain_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shortlink_ownership_backfill_items item WHERE item.tenant_id = sl.tenant_id AND item.link_id = sl.id ) ORDER BY sl.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert:
INSERT IGNORE INTO shortlink_ownership_backfill_items ( tenant_id, link_id, application_id, domain_id, status, attempts ) VALUES
(#{tenantId}, #{linkId}, #{applicationId}, #{domainId}, 'PENDING', 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE shortlink_ownership_backfill_checkpoints SET last_scanned_link_id = #{lastScannedLinkId}, scan_exhausted = #{scanExhausted}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT checkpoint.last_scanned_link_id, checkpoint.scan_exhausted, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN item.status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN item.status = 'RETRYABLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS retryable_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN item.status = 'PERMANENT_FAILURE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS permanent_failure_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN item.status = 'RECONCILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reconciled_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN item.status = 'ALREADY_RECONCILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS already_reconciled_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN item.status = 'NOT_FOUND' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS not_found_count FROM shortlink_ownership_backfill_checkpoints checkpoint LEFT JOIN shortlink_ownership_backfill_items item ON item.tenant_id = checkpoint.tenant_id WHERE checkpoint.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY checkpoint.tenant_id, checkpoint.last_scanned_link_id, checkpoint.scan_exhausted
